content: Each n-gram token at timestep INLINEFORM0 is generated by the previous, present and next token and embedded into vectors as shown in uni,bi,tri. The unigram embedding at timestep INLINEFORM1 is a unigram embedding of the current token INLINEFORM2 . The bigram embedding vector at timestep INLINEFORM3 is a bigram embedding of the previous and present tokens INLINEFORM4 , and the trigram embedding vector at timestep INLINEFORM5 is a trigram embedding of the previous, present and next tokens INLINEFORM6 : DISPLAYFORM0 DISPLAYFORM1
